note: Honduras: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90 days (Taiwan 3 months, the Dominican Republic 60), extendable by 30; British citizens need a visa since 15 August 2024; everyone else needs a visa (holders of Schengen, Canadian or US visas may enter: not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy. Read on 2026-11-03 against the CA-4 classification of visas (El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras and Nicaragua, 23 January 2019), the primary the Dirección General de Migración y Extranjería publishes: it gives no lengths and is older than the changes Wikipedia's copy records since, so it is recorded here and not held; where it differs (its categories for some passports), the current figures are kept.
